common_name: Delta Fuchsia Crapemyrtle (Dark-Foliage Fuchsia-Pink Crape Myrtle)

planting.note: Set container-grown plants in full sun in late winter through fall, keeping the root ball slightly above grade for good drainage; this Delta-series selection reaches small-tree size, so give it room away from structures and walkways.

directions: Delta Fuchsia joins the other Delta-series crapemyrtles with its deep-toned summer foliage, but stands apart through its vivid fuchsia-pink flower clusters that open steadily from early to late summer. It grows into a small multi-trunk tree, so it earns its space as a specimen, screen, or street-side planting rather than a tight foundation shrub. Keep new plantings watered on a regular schedule through their first couple of growing seasons, after which established plants tolerate heat and dry spells well. A light late-winter shaping cut is all it needs, since over-pruning sacrifices next season's bloom wood.
sources: Southern Living Plant Collection official site
